design: Repeat the previous early-only selection of the first pooled-local versus legacy-veto reversal with a loss beyond the frozen tolerance. Thin the shared two-block fit to the exact net count of the third early block, preserving its time and shift strata up to integer rounding. Draw each prompt and control histogram without replacement within strata. Hold the third and fourth validation blocks fixed. Freeze a diagnostic choice using median validation margins and the same tolerance rule, then pair only the selected window's late blocks. Replay the previous selected case as a retrospective diagnostic with the same thinning design.
boundary: Thinning is conditional on the observed prompt and shifted pair histograms. Pairs can share pulses and shifted controls can be dependent, so resampling frequencies describe the stated thinning procedure and supply no sampling p-value or causal decomposition of timing drift.
